newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products steady, but mogas again jacked up.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, but mogas again jacked up.

text.p: NWE oil products were broadly steady on Thursday, except gasoline barges which again rose sharply, dealers said.

Eurograde gasoline barges were some $2 a tonne higher, offered at $199. One rumour circulated of a deal at that level, but none in the market could confirm the parties involved, although one trader seemed prepared to pay almost that much.
"It's some big hype spread by whoever. It looks like it didn't happen," one trader said.
The August/September swap spread widened to a backwardation of $6/$6.50 a tonne.
Regular barges were little changed, at around $185 fob.

Heating oil barges were little changed as IPE August gas oil futures added about 50 cents. Prompt deliveries were again offered at IPE August +50 cents fob Rotterdam. Offers for first half August loadings were at +75 cents/+$1.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded at $90.25 fob Rotterdam and $91 fob Antwerp. Later offers were at $90.50 fob Rotterdam, very slightly higher than at Wednesday's close.
